sections.title: 1. Getting started
body: Sign up at jobsdfy.com with your email and name, tick the Terms & Conditions box and confirm your email.
Add your mobile number. It is saved straight away and marked Not Verified until you enter the text code. Some features stay locked until it is verified.
Finish Onboarding. In the left menu, 'Profile - Onboarding' flashes until your onboarding is complete. Checking jobs, fit scores and Quick Apply rely on it, so do this first.

sections.title: 2. Building your profile
body: Profile holds About Me, Work History, Education, Achievements, References and CV Versions.
Upload CV: use the Upload CV button at the top of About Me. Your CV is read and the fields are filled in for you to check before saving.
Talk to Me: every section has a voice button. Joby, the voice assistant, asks questions and you answer out loud.
Choose what you are adding at the start (About Me, a job, a skill, an achievement, education).
Your words appear on screen as you speak. Press Pause to stop the microphone and correct any spelling, then Resume.
Add names, company names and technical terms to My Dictionary so they are spelled correctly.
Press Stop & Save. Your answers are turned into profile entries and saved. The full conversation is also kept in your Knowledgebase so nothing is lost.
Microphone: pick your microphone (for example a Shure mic) from the list next to Start Talking and press Test mic.

sections.title: 3. Checking a job
body: Go to Check a Job and paste a job link or the job text.
LinkedIn does not allow automatic reading of its pages. Copy the job text from LinkedIn and paste it, or use the JobsDFY Chrome extension.
JobsDFY checks your dealbreakers first (salary, location, visa, work model), then gives a fit score and a verdict: GO (green), REVIEW (amber) or STOP (red).
Nothing is ever sent to an employer automatically. You approve every application.

sections.title: 4. Applying
body: From a job, open Quick Apply to generate a tailored CV and cover letter (an application pack).
Review and edit everything before you submit it yourself.
Track progress in Jobs: saved, applied, interview, closed.

sections.title: 5. Growth tools
body: Interview Practice: rehearse with the AI interviewer and get feedback.

Intellectual Foundation (books), Character & Media Insights (movies), Brain Dump, Thought Leadership (social), Assessments, Photo Gallery and Autobiography help build a fuller picture of you for employers.
Tasks and Calendar / Events keep your search organised.

sections.title: 6. Credits and plans
body: New accounts start with 12 credits. AI actions such as fit checks, CV generation and voice sessions use credits.
Earn extra credits by completing profile steps and by inviting friends with your link (jobsdfy.com/r/your-code).
Buy credit packs or a Pro / Premium plan on the Pricing page. Cancel any time from Pricing.

sections.title: 7. Referrals and affiliates
body: Invite a friend link: jobsdfy.com/r/your-code. Affiliate link: jobsdfy.com/a/AFF-your-code.
Affiliate commission is based on rolling 30-day performance. See the Affiliate Terms page.

sections.title: 8. Settings and help
body: Settings: phone verification, Light / Dark / System appearance, referral link and account deletion.
Use the search bar at the top of the app to jump to any page or find a saved job.
Support: raise a ticket from the Support page. The chat bubble (when enabled) connects you to our assistant.

sections.title: 9. Privacy and ownership
body: Your data is only visible to you and authorised JobsDFY administrators.
The JobsDFY platform, code, design and concept are the intellectual property of Anthony Mallett. See Terms & Conditions.
